newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Red Box falls as takeover plan dropped.
newsitem.headline: Red Box falls as takeover plan dropped.

text.p: Shares of Red Box (Malaysia) Bhd fell to a new low for the year on news a planned takeover of the company has been dropped, dealers said.
Around 0218 GMT, the stock was down 6.77 percent or 26 cents to 3.58 ringgit on volume of 40,000 shares.
The stock's previous 12-month low was 3.84 ringgit.

Red Box, which makes and sell photo albums and related stationery products, said on Friday it had terminated a deal under which it was to be taken over by a private company through an asset injection.
Red Box had been planning to issue 88 million at 7.0 ringgit each to Usaha Sama Timur Sdn Bhd was to acquire a 57.52 percent of the company.
"The news is out and seven ringgit was too expensive anyway," said a dealer at a Malaysian brokerage.
